design_gotchas.title: Mixed New vs. Legacy Silicon Shipments Change Thermal Resistance
design_gotchas.detail: Non-M3 orderable TPS73633DBVR reels may ship either legacy or new silicon depending on CSO fab code (p.28). SOT-23-5 RθJA differs substantially between new silicon (185.2°C/W, p.4) and legacy silicon (221.9°C/W, p.5). Design thermal budgets against the worst-case 221.9°C/W value unless explicitly locking to an M3 suffix.

design_gotchas.title: Tying EN to VIN Disables Reverse-Current Blocking & Risks Startup Overshoot
design_gotchas.detail: Inherent NMOS reverse-current blocking (0.1 uA typ) only operates when the pass FET is turned off via VEN <= 0.5 V before VIN collapses (p.6, p.18). Hard-wiring EN directly to VIN leaves the NMOS channel conducting during input collapse and can cause output overshoot on slow VIN ramps.

design_gotchas.title: SOT-23-5 Cannot Sustain Full 400 mA from a 5 V Input Rail
design_gotchas.detail: At VIN = 5.0 V to VOUT = 3.3 V and IOUT = 400 mA, power dissipation is 0.68 W, producing 126°C–151°C junction rise in SOT-23-5 (DBV). Section 8.2.2 (p.20) explicitly advises against using the DBV package for 5 V-to-3.3 V at 400 mA; use SOT-223 (DCQ) or WSON (DRB) or derate load current.

design_gotchas.title: Ultra-Low COUT*ESR Product Can Ring & Foldback Latches Near 0 mA Below -0.2 V
design_gotchas.detail: Although cap-free stable, paralleling multiple ultra-low-ESR MLCCs such that COUT * ESR_total < 50 nOhm*F can induce ringing on fast load transients (p.21). Additionally, forcing OUT below -0.2 V drives foldback current limit to 0 mA (p.18), requiring a Schottky clamp if negative bus contention is possible.

typical_use_cases: Ultra-low-dropout 3.6 V-to-3.3 V or 3.8 V-to-3.3 V post-regulation for RF and FPGA I/O rails
Space-constrained designs eliminating bulky output capacitors via cap-free NMOS stability
Low-noise 3.3 V analog sensor and PLL rails using Pin 4 NR bypass capacitor
Candidate drop-in upgrade over standard SOT-23-5 BYPASS-pin LDOs when low dropout is prioritized
engineering_summary: The TI TPS73633DBVR is a 400 mA capacitor-free NMOS LDO in SOT-23-5 (DBV) featuring 75 mV typical dropout at full load, ±1% accuracy over temperature, and 28 uVRMS low noise via its Pin 4 NR capacitor. Because its charge-pump NMOS follower requires no output capacitor for stability and offers reverse-current blocking when disabled, it is a strong candidate drop-in for SOT-23-5 BYPASS-pin footprints after verifying VIN <= 5.5 V, EN sequencing, and SOT-23-5 thermal dissipation limits before production.

Verified legacy vs new silicon thermal delta (221.9°C/W vs 185.2°C/W) and cap-free stability constraints on p.5, p.20-21.
